scopes.detail: QooIM 2026-10-21: accepted with reservation (decision card option B). Reviewed the 88 Debian copyright files and Node LICENSE. Residual: per-component notices for Node bundled OpenSSL/V8/ICU and Debian source-offer mechanics are not individually confirmed.

QooIM 2026-10-21: accepted (decision card option A) with explicit attribution decision. Reviewed 82 bundled packages; 12 missing notices were supplemented from exact tarballs, imurmurhash uses the upstream master LICENSE, and @npmcli/agent/eastasianwidth/err-code use the recorded derived-attribution candidates, not artifact texts. pnpm.cjs bundled scope and placing supplements in the image remain follow-ups.

QooIM 2026-10-21: accepted with explicit reservation (decision card option B). Reviewed the Next 16.4.2 and @next/swc-linux-arm64-gnu/musl package-level MIT declarations and the two native binary digests. The release artifact has no packages/next-swc/Cargo.lock and no build-level crate graph, so per-crate Rust licenses/notices were not obtained and static-linking obligations were not independently verified. This sign-off accepts that residual risk; it must not be read as verified per-crate clearance.

QooIM 2026-10-21: accepted with reservation (decision card option B). Reviewed esbuild MIT, golang.org/x/sys BSD-3-Clause and Go 1.26.5 LICENSE. Residual: Go runtime notice delivery and a frozen-image binary hash recheck before release.

QooIM 2026-10-21: accepted with reservation (decision card option B) as a separate database image/aggregate distribution. Reviewed 53 apk packages (46 APKINDEX matches), the undeclared .postgresql-rundeps meta package, 8 GPL-2.0-only base packages, and upstream licenses for OpenSSL/OpenLDAP/nghttp2/zlib/tzdata. Residual: Alpine copyright/APKBUILD notices, undeclared-package explanation, and the recorded GPL/AGPL separate-work position.
